name: Inbox-Watch Orphan Cleanup Automation
description: Workspace-global inbox-watch orphan accumulation: prior-session watchers detach (PPID becomes 1) when Claude Code Bash-tool wrappers die uncleanly. New sessions trip the single-watcher guard against these orphans and exit, leaving the orphan watcher in place — but its stdout is disconnected from any current task tracker, so push notifications fire to dev-null. Net: agents are deaf to real-time inbox pushes for the entire session despite a watcher being objectively alive on the host. Surfaced 2026-04-29 by 1.3.0_DS_CompLearns brief; empirically reproduced in 1.0.0_SA_CTO same day. Affects every agent serial, every session.

Both STAGED, parallelizable. 0 COMPLETE / 2 STAGED.
